title: Banda’s Severed Head and Posthumous Signs

blocks.text: After execution, the legend continues through the image of Banda’s severed head displayed publicly while his body or remains are enclosed to inspire fear.
In confinement he warns the keepers to change what holds him, and when they ignore him they are struck blind until they begin trusting his words.
The severed head and the uncanny signs around it become part of Banda’s posthumous miracle-cycle.
